articles.title: Crypto isn’t a partisan fight, proven by data
articles.snippet: Treating crypto as a political battleground only makes it harder to build the secure, transparent, American-made financial system that most Americans say they want, argues DeFi Education Fund’s Jennifer Rosenthal.

articles.title: Kospi surges 7% as SK Hynix earnings fuel AI stock rebound
articles.snippet: South Korean chipmakers led a broader AI recovery after SK Hynix reported a sevenfold profit surge and announced another $45 billion in shareholder returns.

articles.title: USDC overtakes USDT in euro stablecoin trading as EU rules reshape market: Kaiko
articles.snippet: USDC’s share of euro stablecoin trading has climbed to 56% since January 2024, with deeper liquidity as exchanges restrict USDT under MiCA.

articles.title: Chip Maker SK Hynix Posts Record Quarter as AI Memory Demand Overwhelms Supply
articles.snippet: SK Hynix's quarterly revenue topped 100 trillion won for the first time, and the chipmaker says memory demand will outrun supply through 2030, with DRAM and HBM sold out through 2029.

articles.title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Keystone Pulls Devices as Stolen Key Opens Door to Fakes
articles.snippet: Attackers obtained the factory key that proves Keystone's hardware wallets are genuine, and 25,964 buyer records were affected. The company says recovery phrases and private keys were not involved.
